why.siteId: The id TextOS addresses the site by. TextOS must list it as a destination of the workspace.
why.workspaceId: Null until the TextOS workspace the site receives from is known. Nothing can be received before.
why.locales: The languages the site publishes. The API writes fr-FR today.
why.contentDocumentFingerprint: sha256 of the ContentDocument@1 JSON Schema the site renders against (content-surface CSE_CORE_MANIFEST.json). This is the value ShortsOS pins; use the one of the schema your site renders.
why.acceptedEngineShas: "any" accepts and records the engine of each release. A list accepts only engines that were reviewed.
